FN-PPFDERG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 167
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/04/2024
House Bill 167 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of certain consumer protections regarding device filters provided by
this bill; however, these obligations may be offset by any civil penalties up to $5,000 per
violation and $50,000 in the aggregate, attorney's fees, or investigation expenses that are
recovered from violators of the provisions of this act and retained by the Attorney General.
Page 1
